title: Cristaux et cohomologie de De Rham : généralités, correspondances Deligne et Berthelot (1965-1969) : notes manuscrites (s.d.), lettre (1965).

deep.reconstruction:
Setting. W is the ring of Witt vectors (of a perfect field of characteristic p). Λ_0, …, Λ_ν are generators subject to two kinds of relation:
- Λ_i^p = [(p^{i+1})!/((p^i)!)^p] · Λ_{i+1} for 0 ≤ i ≤ ν−1;
- Λ_ν^p = 0.

What the Λ_i are. These are exactly the relations satisfied by the divided powers Λ_i = γ_{p^i}(T) = T^{p^i}/(p^i)! in the divided-power polynomial algebra W⟨T⟩. Indeed γ_m(x)^p = ((pm)!/(m!)^p) γ_{pm}(x). The coefficient c_i = (p^{i+1})!/((p^i)!)^p has p-adic valuation exactly 1, so c_i = p · unit. The extra relation Λ_ν^p = 0 truncates the algebra. It kills every γ_n with n ≥ p^{ν+1}, so the ring is W⟨T⟩/(γ_n : n ≥ p^{ν+1}), a truncated PD-polynomial algebra over W.

Claim. Λ_0^{a_0}⋯Λ_ν^{a_ν} = 0 whenever Σ a_i p^i ≥ p^{ν+1}. A first attempt by induction on Σ a_i is crossed out.

Lemma (normal form). Every monomial Λ^a equals c · Λ_0^{b_0}⋯Λ_ν^{b_ν}, with:
- c ∈ W;
- 0 ≤ b_i ≤ p−1 for i < ν, and b_ν arbitrary;
- the 'weight' Σ a_i p^i = Σ b_i p^i preserved.

Proof of the lemma (carrying in base p). If some a_i ≥ p with i < ν, write a_i = p q_i + α_i. Then Λ_i^{a_i} = (c_i Λ_{i+1})^{q_i} Λ_i^{α_i}. This moves q_i to the exponent of Λ_{i+1} and leaves the weight unchanged, since α_i p^i + (a_{i+1} + q_i) p^{i+1} = a_i p^i + a_{i+1} p^{i+1}. Proceeding from i = 0 upward gives the normal form.

Proof of the claim. If Σ b_i p^i ≥ p^{ν+1} with b_i ≤ p−1 for i < ν, then Σ_{i<ν} b_i p^i ≤ p^ν − 1. Hence b_ν p^ν > p^{ν+1} − p^ν, so b_ν ≥ p and Λ_ν^{b_ν} is a multiple of Λ_ν^p = 0.

Purpose. This is a technical lemma supporting the previous page. There the rings A^{(ν)}, W^{(ν)}, W^{(ν,r)} (with generators Θ_i) and the filtration pieces E_i are given explicit W-bases / normal forms. This is presumably for computing PD-envelopes and crystalline (De Rham) cohomology of simple truncated objects such as k[T]/(T^{p^ν}) or W_n-type thickenings, in the 'Cristaux' context.
errors: No mathematical error. The upward induction is only sketched: carrying at level i may create a new excess at level i+1, so one must process i = 0, 1, …, ν−1 in order. This is implicit and harmless.
The coefficient is written ambiguously as p^{i+1}!/(p^i!)^p. It means (p^{i+1})!/((p^i)!)^p, which equals p times a unit; Grothendieck does not state that it is p times a unit here.

ideas.what: Presentation of the (truncated) divided-power polynomial algebra over W by generators γ_{p^i}(T) with relations γ_{p^i}^p = ((p^{i+1})!/((p^i)!)^p) γ_{p^{i+1}}
ideas.modern_name: Standard presentation of the PD polynomial algebra Z_(p)⟨T⟩ / W⟨T⟩
ideas.where_published: Standard in Berthelot's thesis and Berthelot–Ogus; not known in Grothendieck's own published texts

ideas.what: Normal form of monomials via base-p carrying, and vanishing of monomials of weight ≥ p^{ν+1}
ideas.modern_name: W-basis of the PD algebra by γ_n, with n written in base p

deep.surprise_reason: This is a routine computational lemma on the structure of a truncated divided-power algebra over Witt vectors, proved correctly by base-p carrying. It is of interest only as evidence of Grothendieck's hands-on PD-envelope calculations around 1965–69; it contains nothing new.
transcription_corrections: The coefficient should read (p^{i+1})!/((p^i)!)^p rather than p^{i+1}!/(p^i!)^p.
'(cela tous seulement)' is a doubtful reading; likely something like '(calcul immédiat)' or '(cela tout seulement)'. It introduces the inference b_ν ≥ p.
'Pour le voir, on procède par récurrence sur ν / sur i': the insertion above the line is most likely an induction index (i, or ν), not '{+ν+}' attached to 'procède'.
In the computation the exponent written a'_i equals α_i (the remainder of a_i mod p); the transcription mixes the notations α_i and a'_i.
